title: Parades and Fireworks
intro: Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! Grab your spot on the curb early, because tonight is all about parades, fireworks, and nighttime spectaculars. The lights are dimming, the music is swelling, and it's showtime.

categories.title: I See the Light
categories.intro: Our film category features the most beautiful lantern scene in Disney history. It's 2010's Tangled. Let your hair down!

clues.clue: What kind of animal is Rapunzel's little sidekick Pascal?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a chameleon. Pascal changes color to hide, but he can never hide that attitude.

clues.clue: What household item does Rapunzel use as her weapon of choice?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a frying pan. Frying pans, who knew, right? Flynn certainly didn't.

clues.clue: What is the real name of the thief who calls himself Flynn Rider?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Eugene Fitzherbert. Not quite as dashing as Flynn Rider, but unlike the wanted posters, his nose is perfect.

clues.clue: What is the name of the pub where Rapunzel learns that even ruffians have dreams?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Snuggly Duckling. Hook Hand wanted to be a concert pianist. We love a dreamer.

clues.clue: The kingdom releases lanterns every year on the lost princess's birthday. How old does Rapunzel turn in the film?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 18. Eighteen years of lanterns, and she finally got to see them up close. Cue happy tears.

categories.title: Light Up the Sky
categories.intro: Fireworks and nighttime spectaculars! Ooh and aah as you answer. I'll be listening for the ooh.

clues.clue: Before many Disney fireworks shows, which tiny pixie flies down from the top of the castle?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tinker Bell. She has been flying over the castle since the 1960s, and she's never once missed her mark.

clues.clue: Which Disneyland nighttime show on the Rivers of America has Mickey battling villains with water, fire, and his imagination?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fantasmic! Some imagination, huh? Mickey versus a giant dragon is never a fair fight for the dragon.

clues.clue: World of Color lights up Paradise Bay with water fountains at which park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney California Adventure. Stand in the splash zone at your own risk. You have been warned.

clues.clue: Which Magic Kingdom fireworks show debuted in 2017, left in 2020, and made a triumphant return in 2023?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Happily Ever After. Disney fans begged and begged, and their wish came true.

clues.clue: Epcot's long-running nighttime show IllumiNations: Reflections of Earth took its final bow in what year?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2019. After about twenty years over World Showcase Lagoon, that giant Earth globe finally rested.

categories.title: Parade Palettes
categories.intro: Color Palettes are back! These are the outfit colors of characters you'd see in a Disney parade. Name the character.

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey Mouse. Red shorts, yellow shoes, white gloves. The boss never goes out of style.

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Donald Duck. A sailor shirt and hat, but famously, no pants. Classic Donald.

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
accept: belle from beauty and the beast
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Belle. That golden ball gown is one of the most iconic dresses in animation.

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White. Blue bodice, yellow skirt, red bow, and the original Disney princess.

clues.clue: These are the colors of which character's classic parade look?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Goofy. Orange turtleneck, black vest, blue pants, and that floppy green hat. Ah-hyuck!

categories.title: Parade Route
categories.intro: Let's head to Main Street and grab a curb spot. This category is all about Disney parades, past and present.

clues.clue: Which famous nighttime parade, covered in thousands of twinkling lights, debuted at Disneyland in 1972?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Main Street Electrical Parade. Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls! You know the rest.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Festival of Fantasy Parade features a fire-breathing dragon from which film?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty. It's Maleficent, in her full steampunk dragon form, breathing real fire.

clues.clue: The Paint the Night parade, with its glowing floats, first debuted at which park in 2014?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hong Kong Disneyland. It came to Disneyland a year later for the 60th anniversary.

clues.clue: What is the name of the bouncy electronic theme song of the Main Street Electrical Parade?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Baroque Hoedown. Beep boop boop beep boop. You heard it. Don't lie.

clues.clue: Which park hosted the nighttime parade SpectroMagic from 1991 to 2010?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Magic Kingdom. SpectroMagic had fiber optics everywhere, and fans still miss it.

categories.title: Showstoppers
categories.intro: Club DJ wanted stage shows! These are the live shows and theaters where you get to sit down, cool off, and be amazed.

clues.clue: Animal Kingdom's big in-the-round musical show is called Festival of the Lion King. Which movie is it based on?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Lion King. Cupcake round, folks. The title gave it away.

clues.clue: At Hollywood Studios, which film's live stage show features the songs Be Our Guest and Gaston?
accept: beauty and the beast live on stage
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beauty and the Beast. Live on stage since 1991. No one performs like Gaston.

clues.clue: The Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular recreates scenes from which Indiana Jones film?
accept: indiana jones and the raiders of the lost ark
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Raiders of the Lost Ark. Yes, the giant boulder rolls, and yes, they pick audience members as extras.

clues.clue: In Mickey's PhilharMagic, Donald gets into trouble after taking what from Mickey?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey's sorcerer hat. Donald never learns. Not from Fantasia, not from anything.

clues.clue: Epcot's The American Adventure is hosted by Audio-Animatronic Benjamin Franklin and which famous author?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mark Twain. Ben Franklin even climbs a staircase in that show. Pretty impressive for a robot.
